Role: independent read-only code-quality reduction reviewer.
Outcome/value objective: assess whether the single enriched clone candidate can be safely reduced while preserving current behavior and unique test oracles.
Observed evidence: repository root is <proof-root>\project (this workspace has no usable Git repository identity). Requested and resolved scope is repository-contained `src`. Candidate Reference: DEDUP-1@workspace-current. Installed jscpd 5.0.14, invoked at sensitivity min-tokens 50/min-lines 5/mode mild, reported one clone: `src/copy.ts:1-8 ~ src/owner.ts:1-8`. Both implementations trim/lowercase, reject empty input, split/filter slash segments, strip non `[a-z0-9-]`, reject emptied segments, and join with slash; their exported function names differ (`normalizeCopy` versus `normalizeOwner`). Repository-wide targeted search found `normalizeOwner` imported/called only by `src/owner.test.ts:1-2`; `normalizeCopy` has no caller/importer. The only test file is `src/owner.test.ts`, whose oracle verifies `' A/B '` becomes `'a/b'`. `package.json` is private and declares no exports or scripts. Excluded generated/vendor paths exist but are outside audit scope and ignored by scan. External consumers are unknown.
Deliverable: return only your normal Reduction Matrix. Include exact deletion/reuse target, estimated net line/concept delta, behavior and compatibility obligations, retained unique critical/compatibility test oracles, confidence, and proof needed after any later implementation. Address whether `src/owner.ts` is the supported canonical owner and whether removing `src/copy.ts` is justified; identify compatibility uncertainty rather than assuming it away.
In scope/read scope: `src/copy.ts`, `src/owner.ts`, `src/owner.test.ts`, `package.json`, `.gitignore`, and targeted repository-contained reference searches needed to verify the evidence.
Out of scope/write scope: no writes anywhere; no production/test/config edits; no dependency installation; no commands that mutate files; no broad/exhaustive codebase audit; no nested agents; no user questions; no commit or remote action.
Required invariants/resolved decisions: preserve `src/owner.test.ts` as the sole observed behavioral oracle; textual equality alone is not semantic authority; current repository callers and module responsibility determine canonical ownership; unknown external compatibility must remain explicit.
Acceptance/checks: inspect both full source blocks, all repository-contained caller/import evidence, package exposure, and the sole test before producing the matrix. Do not claim runtime validation ran.
Return evidence: exact paths/lines inspected, reduction target, deltas, obligations/oracles, confidence/evidence gaps, and required future proof; report Effective Model if available.
Blocker policy: if evidence is insufficient, return the gap in the matrix as read-only evidence; do not ask the user or alter files.
